description: This file defines the Styles class, which manages a collection of style definitions within the MigraDoc document object model. It provides methods for adding, retrieving, cloning, and serializing styles, as well as initializing predefined built-in styles.

classes.name: Styles
classes.description: A collection managing style objects used in document formatting, including predefined styles, adding, retrieving, serializing, and visiting styles.

classes.name: Styles.StylesValues
classes.description: A nested class providing internal nullable implementation details for Styles properties, such as comments.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the Styles collection.

methods.name: this[string? styleName]
methods.description: Retrieves a style by its name, case-insensitive, or null if not found.

methods.name: this[int index]
methods.description: Retrieves a style by its index in the collection.

methods.name: GetIndex
methods.description: Finds the index of a style by its name, case-insensitive, or returns -1 if not found.

methods.name: AddStyle
methods.description: Adds a new style with specified name and base style name to the collection.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a style object to the collection, ensuring base styles exist and cloning if necessary.

methods.name: SetupStyles
methods.description: Initializes built-in styles with default formatting.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Converts the entire Styles collection into DDL format.

methods.name: SerializeStyle
methods.description: Serializes an individual style, taking care to serialize base styles first to handle dependencies.

methods.name: AcceptVisitor
methods.description: Allows a DocumentObjectVisitor to visit the styles and their base styles (part of IVisitable implementation).

methods.name: VisitStyle
methods.description: Recursively visits a style and its base style to ensure proper visitation order.

methods.name: Meta
methods.description: Provides metadata about the Styles class.
